report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-09-28T17:59:07Z to 18:04:07Z) checkout did show real failures: sampled checkout spans for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder carried error=true with otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and the same traces carried HTTP 500 on frontend POST /api/checkout, frontend-proxy ingress and load-generator POST. The failing dependency call in those traces is product-catalog: checkout's client span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and the product-catalog server span of the same operation both report ERROR with otel.status_description 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled', and a visible CHILD_OF parent reference links the checkout client span to the product-catalog server span. Traces dd282313e66cc68f768faedb861a6aa1, 896af2bc6c8e7e6537da30bc8c65934b and d11a8edabd5633df104857e97553c2c7 show this checkout failure chain. payment, cart, currency, shipping and email show no error-status spans in the sampled evidence for this window and no error-status latency/error series beyond returned zero values; the same product-catalog fault also produced HTTP 500s on frontend product and recommendation routes. No elevated dependency-call latency is visible: checkout's client-side p95 latency (rpc_client_duration_milliseconds) for Charge, GetProduct, ShipOrder, GetCart, GetQuote, Convert and EmptyCart sits in the same range across all six 5-minute points available from 17:39:07 to 18:04:07. The one latency datapoint that stands out is checkout server-side PlaceOrder p95 of 412.5 ms in the current window, the highest of the six available points (64.7-235 ms earlier), but that rests on roughly 5-8 calls, so it is stated as a hypothesis, not a conclusion. Note a metric/trace inconsistency: traces_span_metrics_calls_total reported 0 for checkout's client oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct STATUS_CODE_ERROR in this window while the sampled traces show 3 such error spans. Overall: checkout failures are corroborated and attributable (in the sampled traces) to the product-catalog GetProduct dependency; whether the error rate is 'elevated' against a pre-incident baseline cannot be established because the earliest metric sample returned for a one-hour query is 17:39:07 and an earlier 5-minute baseline window returned no data.

claims.text: Sampled checkout spans for operation oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder carried error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=13 in traces dd282313e66cc68f768faedb861a6aa1, 896af2bc6c8e7e6537da30bc8c65934b and d11a8edabd5633df104857e97553c2c7; the shown span_groups for service checkout count 3 error rows of 10 PlaceOrder spans.

The checkout error spans carry otel.status_description and exception.message 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product #"OLJCESPC7Z"'' and the paired checkout client span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct carries otel.status_description 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled' with rpc.grpc.status_code=13.

A visible parent reference forms a checkout-to-product-catalog call edge: checkout client span 18203d6e37340f04 (trace 896af2bc6c8e7e6537da30bc8c65934b) is the CHILD_OF parent of product-catalog server span 0146f663e7e52410 of the same operation, both ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13.

The failures surfaced to callers as HTTP 500: in the sampled checkout traces, frontend POST /api/checkout shows http.status_code=500, and frontend-proxy 'ingress'/'router frontend egress' and load-generator POST show error=true with http.status_code 500.

The product-catalog fault was not limited to the checkout path: additional product-catalog error traces caf9f1f55684cb445139f16512420df8 (frontend GET /api/products/{productId} 500), bfe7b5e430adb043146853cbe88453ca (same route 500), c1cc15e29673e5afbef81fb7be8d87d0 and 724b06c22b240568a4deaf9d7bc5dbc9 (frontend GET /api/recommendations 500), 1362b34792bd2c8f9f7d186634ac8d7f and eff6d5e51a6fa3de67c5cb13cb6c0522 all show product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct server spans with error=true and otel.status_description 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled'.

payment shows no failures in the window: all sampled payment spans (grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and the internal 'charge' operation) have rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and durations 1.2-10.7 ms, and the checkout-side client spans oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge are also rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (visible edges e.g. trace 362f6969283941902efec41fcde4a759 between checkout span 404a4307398a01c0 and payment span afe727edf33f8349).

In the returned metric data for the last-5-minute window the checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with STATUS_CODE_ERROR has the value 0, and in the one-hour series that same series is 0 at both 17:59:07 and 18:04:07 while payment's own grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR series is likewise 0 at both points.

cart, currency, shipping and email show no error-status rows in the sampled spans (cart POST/POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart/flagd ResolveBoolean all rpc.grpc.status_code=0, shipping GetQuote/ShipOrder and email POST /send_order_confirmation send_email all 200 or rpc.grpc.status_code=0, currency Convert with otel.status_code=OK), and in the last-5-minute metric response only STATUS_CODE_UNSET (and currency STATUS_CODE_OK) series were returned for those services, with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series returned at all.

No dependency-call latency elevation is visible on checkout's client spans: across the six 5-minute points from 17:39:07 to 18:04:07 the p95 rpc_client_duration for checkout is Charge 47.5/46.25/39.65/23.71/45.0/46.25 ms, GetProduct 4.75 ms at every point, ShipOrder 4.75 ms (NaN at one point), GetCart 4.75-45 ms, GetQuote 9.75-47.5 ms, Convert 4.75-30 ms and EmptyCart NaN/23.3-220 ms.

Checkout server-side PlaceOrder p95 (rpc_server_duration_milliseconds) across the six available 5-minute points is 235, 227.5, 64.65, 92.5, 220 and 412.5 ms, with the current 17:59:07-18:04:07 window the highest; product-catalog GetProduct and ListProducts server p95 stay at ~4.75-4.85 ms throughout.

The one-hour error series shows two distinct episodes rather than a single continuous checkout error state: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 6.57 at 17:49:07 and 3.75 at 17:54:07, absent/0 at 17:59:07 and 1.25 at 18:04:07, while product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct STATUS_CODE_ERROR appears only at 18:04:07 with 7.14; the checkout client and payment server Charge error series are 0 in both of the last two windows.

No comparable earlier baseline was returned: in the one-hour query the earliest metric sample is 17:39:07 (source_start_at), meaning no point covers the 17:04:07-17:39:07 interval, and the two dedicated 5-minute baseline queries for 17:24:07-17:29:07 and the 17:04:07-18:04:07 error query for cart/currency/shipping/email returned status no_data with empty content.

The checkout failures in the last 5 minutes originate in the product-catalog dependency: the product-catalog GetProduct call returns gRPC status 13 with the message naming a 'Product Catalog Fail' feature flag, which checkout reports as 'failed to prepare order: failed to get product' and the frontend then exposes as HTTP 500. The visible parent-child edges support propagation, but no feature-flag configuration or change event was observed, so the injected-flag mechanism itself remains inferred.
